title: Live-Action The Samurai and the Prisoner Film Drops to #4, New Sgt. Frog Film to #10
content: Kiyoshi Kurosawa 's live-action film adaptation of Honobu Yonezawa 's The Samurai and the Prisoner ( Kokurōjō ) samurai historical mystery novel dropped from #3 to #4 in its third weekend. The film earned 94,901,360 yen (about US$585,000) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Promise Me the Spotlight Gets an Anime Adaptation
content: Another idol love story is on the horizon. Jun Wakatsuki’s Promise Me the Spotlight (W atashi o Sentā ni Suru to Chikaimasuka?) is getting an anime adaptation. The anime’s production team released a visual alongside the adaptation announcement and launched an official website and X account.
author: Anime Corner

title: Strange Pictures Manga Ends on July 21
content: This year's 14th issue of Futabasha 's Manga Action magazine revealed on Tuesday that Kikō Aiba 's manga adaptation of Uketsu 's original novel Strange Pictures ( Henna E ) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on July 21. The manga entered its final arc in November 2025.
author: ANN

title: Toei Animation's Foxing: Kitsuné-tsuki Anime Screens in Festivals
content: Toei Animation announced on Thursday that FOXING: Kitsuné-tsuki , a new short anime film by its Eterna Animation brand, will screen in a number of festivals in the film festival circuit.
author: ANN

title: Tsubasa to Hotaru's Nana Haruta, Artist maki Launch New Manga
content: The August issue of Shueisha 's Ribon magazine announced on July 3 that manga authors Nana Haruta ( Tsubasa to Hotaru ) and maki will launch a new manga titled Sugarless Romance in the magazine's next issue on August 3. Haruta is credited for the original story, and maki is drawing the manga.
author: ANN

title: Masashi Ueda's Otoboke Buchō Dairi, Kariage-kun, Shin Furiten-kun Manga End
content: Manga author Masashi Ueda ended the serialization of his Otoboke Buchō Dairi and Kariage-kun manga on Tuesday, and his Shin Furiten-kun manga will end on July 10. title: Kadokawa CEO Takeshi Natsuno Retains Positions After Shareholder Vote
content: Takeshi Natsuno retains his positions as both the CEO and a board member of Kadokawa , after receiving enough votes during the company's 12th annual general meeting of shareholders on Wednesday.

title: Yosuke Matsumoto's Monochrome Days Manga Ends in Next Chapter on August 2
content: Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service publishes the manga in English and describes the series: A reliable office worker, Hanaichi Fudo, undoubtedly had a gift for the arts but gave up on his dreams of becoming an artist to lead a normal life.
